description: A booking reference that belongs to another Carrier: the line quotes a reference of a Carrier cost that exists, but for another Carrier. The ERP matches against the invoicing Carrier's own costs only, so the line is an Unknown booking and the other Carrier's cost and reference are not a candidate. Known answer: Unknown booking with no candidate, never Accept, and the other Carrier's name never appears.

setup.seed: Take a delivered Booking of Zulu Freight (not CAR-0001) to an Open Carrier cost with the reference ZF-90311. Submit the Carrier invoice EVAL-OTHER-1 of CAR-0001 with one line whose reference is ZF-90311.

input: Explain why the line "ZF-90311" of Carrier invoice "EVAL-OTHER-1" of Carrier "CAR-0001" did not match, and whether it may still resolve.

explanation.rubric: Says no Carrier cost has arrived under the reference ZF-90311 for this Carrier (an Unknown booking). Offers no other Carrier's cost as a candidate and does not name another Carrier.
